results.name: Behind Neck Press Resistance Band Cable
instructions: Stand tall with your back straight, feet shoulder-width apart, and a resistance band under your feet.
Hold the ends of the band near your shoulders with your arms folded at the sides.
Stretch the band by extending your arms overhead.
As your arms become straight, return to the initial position, and repeat.
tips: Engage your core to help stabilize your body and prevent unnecessary movement.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you press the band upwards and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Keep your elbows slightly bent at the top of the movement to avoid locking them out.
results.description: Behind Neck Press Resistance Band Cable is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Back.

results.name: Bent Over Rear Delt Fly Dumbbell
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips until your torso is almost parallel to the floor. Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Let the dumbbells hang directly below you with your arms fully extended. Maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.

Lift the dumbbells out to the sides by raising your arms until they are in line with your shoulders. Keep a slight bend in your elbows and focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position by bringing your arms back down. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back flat and avoid rounding your shoulders or lower back.
Focus on using your rear deltoids to lift the weights, not your traps or biceps.
Avoid using momentum or swinging your body to lift the dumbbells.
results.description: Bent Over Rear Delt Fly Dumbbell is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Bent Over Rear Deltoid Fly Resistance Band
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the ends of the resistance band anchored under your feet. Hinge at the hips with a slight bend in your knees to bring your torso almost parallel to the floor.
Start with your arms hanging down towards the floor, palms facing back, and a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides, forming a "T" shape, keeping a slight bend in your elbows and leading with your elbows. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise to avoid straining your lower back.
Keep your elbows slightly bent to avoid joint strain and focus on lifting with your shoulders.
Use a controlled motion to raise and lower your arms, preventing any jerking movements.
results.description: Bent Over Rear Deltoid Fly Resistance Band is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Bodyweight Bent Over Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent, until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
Allow your arms to hang straight down from your shoulders.
Lift your arms out to the sides until they are in line with your shoulders, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower your arms back down in a controlled manner and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and engage your core to maintain proper form throughout the exercise.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together as you lift your arms to maximize muscle activation.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to avoid using momentum and to target the rear deltoids effectively.
results.description: Bodyweight Bent Over Rear Delt Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Bodyweight Standing Around World Wall Supported
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your back against a wall for support.
Extend your arms to the sides of your torso with palms facing forward.
Move your arms in a circular motion, bringing them overhead, and back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back flat against the wall to maintain proper alignment and support.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows to reduce strain on your joints.
Perform the arm movements slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Standing Around World Wall Supported is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Upper Chest.

results.name: Bodyweight Standing Military Press Wall Supported
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your back against a wall for support, upper arms parallel to the floor, and arms bent at 90 degrees, fingers pointing at the ceiling.
Press your hands upward, extending your arms fully overhead.
Lower your hands back to shoulder level to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on keeping your back and head in contact with the wall to maintain proper alignment.
Ensure a full range of motion by fully extending your arms without locking your elbows.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you press up and inhaling as you lower your arms.
results.description: Bodyweight Standing Military Press Wall Supported is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Upper Chest.

results.name: Bodyweight Standing Military Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, upper arms parallel to the floor, and arms bent at 90 degrees, fingers pointing at the ceiling.
Press your hands upward, extending your arms fully overhead.
Lower your hands back to shoulder level to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and avoid arching your back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation.
Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears throughout the exercise.
results.description: Bodyweight Standing Military Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Upper Chest, Triceps.

results.name: Bodyweight Standing Shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands on your hips.
Raise your shoulders up towards your ears.
Lower your shoulders back to the starting position and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain an upright posture to ensure proper form.
Avoid rolling your shoulders; focus on lifting them straight up and down.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation.
results.description: Bodyweight Standing Shrug is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Neck.

results.name: Cable 30 Degree Shrug
instructions: Stand upright between two low cable pulleys and hold the handles at your sides with a neutral grip and your arms fully extended.
Elevate your shoulders toward your ears while keeping your arms straight and your torso still.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement while squeezing your upper back muscles.
Lower your shoulders slowly to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms fully extended throughout the exercise.
Squeeze your upper trapezius at the top of each repetition.
Keep your neck in a neutral position and look straight ahead.
Inhale as you lower your shoulders and exhale as you shrug upward.
results.description: Cable 30 Degree Shrug is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Shoulders, Forearms.

results.name: Cable Bent Over One Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley on a cable machine. Stand to the side of the machine with your right side facing it, and grasp the handle with the left hand, allowing the cable to cross in front of your body.
Bend at the hips until your upper body is nearly parallel to the floor, keeping your knees slightly bent and your back flat. Let the arm holding the handle hang straight down.
Raise the handle out to the side until your hand is at shoulder level, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Slowly lower the handle back to the starting position. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce the risk of injury.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow throughout the exercise to reduce strain on your joints.
Avoid using momentum or swinging your body; focus on isolating the shoulder muscle.
results.description: Cable Bent Over One Arm Lateral Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Core.
